sources_used: web search UK DDR/Pump It Up community locations

findings.name: Lucky Star
findings.evidence_quote: Lucky Star Family Amusements. Find it at: 2 Station Road – which is directly opposite South Pier. The arcade is just off the main promenade junction.
findings.note: Open family amusements arcade opposite South Pier, Blackpool. ZIv notes only HOTD Scarlet Dawn. No rhythm-game mentions found; seaside redemption/video mix. Not confirmed_none (inventory not fully catalogued).

findings.name: Lucky Strike Amusements
findings.evidence_quote: Lucky Strike Amusements - Hemsby seaside arcade entry with hours Mon-Sun 11:00-23:00; no games listed on ZIv.
findings.note: Typical Hemsby seafront amusement arcade. No public game list or rhythm mentions found. Unknown.

findings.name: MB's Amusements
findings.evidence_quote: Cabs noted on import: Need for Speed: Carbon. Website path mbsfunhouse.co.uk/mbs-arcade.html returned 404.
findings.note: Hemsby funhouse arcade. Official arcade page dead. Only racing cab noted; no rhythm evidence either way.

findings.name: MFA Bowl (Whitstable)
findings.evidence_quote: wtf no more euro mix (lmaosamsddr comment). Current games: Mario Kart Arcade GP 2; The Fast and the Furious: Drift (2P).
findings.note: Bowling venue. Player-confirmed removal of Dancing Stage Euromix. Remaining listed cabs are racing only. Historical ddr gone.

findings.name: Magic Cavern
findings.evidence_quote: Cabs: Big Buck Hunter. Porthcawl Eastern Promenade seaside arcade.
findings.note: Porthcawl seaside arcade. Only Big Buck Hunter noted on ZIv. No rhythm evidence found.

findings.name: Magic City
findings.evidence_quote: Picture gallery includes titles 'EM2 @ Magic City' and 'DDR A IN ESSEX'. Current games list has Mario Kart GP DX, Time Crisis 4, Rambo, etc. but no DDR entry. Updated 2021-05-17.
findings.note: Clacton Pier Avenue Magic City. Historical Euromix 2 and DDR A photos exist; not on current ZIv games table (stale 2021). Do not assume still present. Needs on-site check.

findings.name: Magic City
findings.evidence_quote: Magic City Amusement Arcade, 38 Marine Parade Great Yarmouth (visit listing).
findings.note: Great Yarmouth Marine Parade Magic City (distinct from Clacton). ZIv empty game list. No rhythm evidence.

findings.name: Majestic Amusements
findings.evidence_quote: 47/48 Marine Parade Great Yarmouth - adjacent to Magic City strip; no games listed on ZIv.
findings.note: GY seafront amusement arcade. No public rhythm-game reports found.

findings.name: Mangos sports bar (Falmouth)
findings.evidence_quote: Cabs: GRID (Twin Cab 2P); Hockey Table; Pac-Man Roller; Pharaoh's Gold; Sonic Sports Basketball; Space Invaders; Time Crisis II.
findings.note: Sports bar at Discovery Quay with a short video/redemption set. Catalogued cabs are racing/shooters/sports; no rhythm titles.

findings.name: Mannings Amusements
findings.evidence_quote: Cabs: Animal Kaiser PLUS; NFS Heat Takedown. Website manningsamusements.co.uk DNS failed at research time.
findings.note: Felixstowe Sea Road amusements. Partial cab notes only; no rhythm evidence.

findings.name: Mansfield Superbowl
findings.evidence_quote: Cabs: Ice Man; Pink Panther Jewel Heist; Sonic Dash Extreme; Super Bikes.
findings.note: Bowling centre redemption/video mix. Listed cabs are ticket/racing only; no rhythm games indicated.

findings.name: Marine Amusements Ltd.
findings.evidence_quote: 1-4 Marine Parade, Gorleston-on-Sea - ZIv entry with no games listed.
findings.note: Gorleston seafront arcade. Nothing findable on rhythm machines.

findings.name: Megazone Laser Centre
findings.evidence_quote: called in to ask about the only ddr cab in leicester. i saw it once but never played on it. rip euromix (troutfishing, ~2023). Games: No games at this location.
findings.note: Primarily laser tag (megazoneleicester.co.uk still open 2026). Historical Euromix removed; no current arcade game list.

findings.name: Merlin’s Amusements
findings.evidence_quote: Cabs: Batman; Dirty Drivin'; MotoGP Arcade; Phantom Motorcycle.
findings.note: Minehead Warren Road amusements. Racing/action cabs only on ZIv; no rhythm evidence.

findings.name: Merrivale Model Village + Old Penny Arcade
findings.evidence_quote: Old penny arcade with retro and vintage British arcade games. Also has a few redemption games and pushers. 2024 UPDATE: classic machines... Final Fight, Street Fighter II, Mortal Kombat, Sega Rally, Time Crisis II, etc. No music games listed.
findings.note: Williamson's Old Penny Arcade + retro video room at Merrivale GY. Detailed 2024 catalog is classic/racing/shooters only. Official site emphasises vintage mechanical amusements.

findings.name: Millers Leisure Centre (Amusements)
findings.evidence_quote: Cabs: Daytona Championship USA; Deal or No Deal; Jurassic Park Arcade (2015); Super Bikes (2P).
findings.note: Chapel St Leonards / Skegness area leisure amusements. Partial non-rhythm list only.

findings.name: Monte Carlo Amusements
findings.evidence_quote: 16 West Parade Rhyl - ZIv entry; 3 images; no games table content for music titles.
findings.note: Rhyl West Parade seafront arcade. No rhythm-game reports found.

findings.name: Mr B's Amusements
findings.evidence_quote: Cabs: Daytona USA (2P); Deal or No Deal; Time Crisis 4.
findings.note: Rhyl West Parade near Monte Carlo. Racing/shooter notes only; no rhythm evidence.

findings.name: Mr Mulligan's Space Golf
findings.evidence_quote: Crazy golf course with a couple of arcade games. Games: Mario Kart Arcade GP DX; The House of the Dead: Scarlet Dawn; Claw Machine; Down The Clown; Lane Master; Simulator (VR). Official site lists crazy golf, electro-darts, pool, shuffleboard, VR, karaoke - not rhythm cabs.
findings.note: Mulligans Newcastle. Visitor inventory + official activities omit tracked rhythm games. Karaoke on site is not a valid map game slug.

findings.name: Mumbles Pier
findings.evidence_quote: Mumbles Pier Amusements offers fun for all ages with prize machines, video games, driving simulators, basketball challenges, 2p pushers and family favourites. WHAT YOU'LL FIND: Prize machines, 2p pushers, Driving simulators, Basketball games, Air hockey, Family arcade favourites, Ticket redemption prizes.
findings.note: Official amusements page enumerates family redemption/sports; ZIv notes match (claw, ice ball, Sonic sports). No rhythm titles.

findings.name: Namco @ Haven Church Farm
findings.evidence_quote: Games: Minecraft Dungeons Arcade; NERF Arcade; Pac-Man Pusher (8P). A holiday park with the usual amenities.
findings.note: Haven holiday-park Namco floor. Catalogued as redemption/ticket family machines only.

findings.name: Namco @ Haven Devon Cliffs
findings.evidence_quote: Current games (2024-04-19): Animal Kaiser PLUS; Minecraft Dungeons; Cruis'n Blast; Super Bikes 3; Bop It; claws; Pac-Man Pusher; Spinner Frenzy; Bowlingo. Historical pictures: 'Devon Cliffs - EuroMIX' and 'Devon Cliffs - Guitar Hero' (not on current list).
findings.note: Had Euromix/Guitar Hero historically; removed from current ZIv games table. Treat as no current rhythm; confidence limited by list completeness.

findings.name: Namco @ Haven Seashore
findings.evidence_quote: RIP DDR A! (LABcrab comment ~2024). Picture 'DDR A Haven Caister' remains. Halo Fireteam Raven location note still says 'To the right of DDR A' but DDR not in active games table. Games list is redemption/racing/shooters.
findings.note: Caister Haven Seashore. Community confirmed DDR A removal. Holiday-park access restricted (booking/key). No current tracked rhythm games.

findings.name: Namco Funscape Gateshead
findings.evidence_quote: i bring dire news: either i'm blind, or the whitecab's gone. didn't spot any replacement, no silvercab or anything. end of an era (juneibyou, ~2026-05 comments). Games table has Mario Kart GP DX, Minecraft Dungeons, Jurassic Park, redemption; no DDR. Picture 'DDR A' historical.
findings.note: Metrocentre Namco Funscape. Long-running DDR A whitecab removed ~May 2026 per regular. No replacement observed. Do not re-list ddr without new visit.

findings.name: Namco Funscape Tamworth
findings.evidence_quote: No rhythm games here now, Euromix 2 and Guitar Hero are long gone. Mario Kart and Star Wars are okay... Games: Mario Kart Arcade GP DX; Super Bikes 2; Star Wars Battle Pod; Terminator Salvation.
findings.note: Explicit ZIv note of no rhythm games. Source is 2019 so confidence unverified for 2026 floor; Bandai Namco still operates site as Funscape. No newer community report found restoring ddr/piu.

findings.name: Namco Station
findings.evidence_quote: Although the venue remains under Bandai Namco ownership, it rebranded under the mainstream Namco Funscape... Namco Station Tamworth. ZIv Namco Station page: No games at this location; last updated 2012-01-13; same B79 7ND as Funscape Tamworth.
findings.note: Legacy name for Tamworth venue now listed as Namco Funscape (sid z371). Treat z2139 as closed/duplicate stub, not a second floor.

findings.name: National Science and Media Museum
findings.evidence_quote: ARCADE GAMES: Recreate the 1980s arcade experience... Gauntlet, Street Fighter II, Galaxian and Space Invaders. ZIv games: Defender; Pac-Man; Point Blank; Street Fighter. Free museum entry / coin classic play.
findings.note: Bradford museum Games Lounge / later Power Up style classic exhibit. Retro classics only; no modern rhythm cabs. Stale ZIv but museum remit is historical gaming.

findings.name: Nessa's Slots
findings.evidence_quote: Cabs: Mario Kart Arcade GP DX; Super Bikes 3. Barry Island Paget Rd.
findings.note: Barry Island amusements/slots. Partial racing list only; no rhythm evidence.

findings.name: New Unity
findings.evidence_quote: Pub with a couple arcade games (same supplier as The World's End). Games: Harley Davidson; Big Buck Hunter Pro; Football Champ. All contactless.
findings.note: Brighton pub. Recent full inventory of three non-rhythm machines only.

findings.name: New York
findings.evidence_quote: The place is now open again as of March 16th, all refurbished (2025-03-20). Long games list: Crazy Taxi, Mario Kart GP 2, HOTD 4, Ghost Squad, Mission Impossible, etc. No DDR or other music games listed.
findings.note: Southend Marine Parade New York arcade reopened March 2025. Extensive ZIv cab list post-refurb without rhythm titles.

findings.name: Nobles amusements
findings.evidence_quote: Cabs: Doodle Jump Arcade; Grand Piano Keys; Lane Master; Monopoly; Sonic Blast Ball; Sonic Dash Extreme; Space Invaders Frenzy; Super Bikes (2P).
findings.note: Portobello / Figgate Lane Edinburgh amusements. Redemption/ticket set; Grand Piano Keys is not a tracked rhythm slug. No bemani/ddr reports.

findings.name: Non Such amusements and snooker club
findings.evidence_quote: 35 Windmill Street Saltcoats Scotland - ZIv entry with no games listed.
findings.note: Snooker club + amusements. No public game inventory or rhythm mentions found.

findings.name: Oasis Amusements
findings.evidence_quote: 57 Beach Rd Hemsby - hours listed; no games on ZIv.
findings.note: Hemsby Beach Road Oasis (distinct from South Shields Oasis). No rhythm evidence.

findings.name: Oasis Amusements
findings.evidence_quote: Cabs: Aliens Armageddon; Bowling Champ; Dino Pop; Flappy Bird; Jurassic Park Arcade; NASCAR Team Racing; Pearl Fishery; Sega Rally Championship; Slam 'n' Jam Jr.; Space Invaders Frenzy; Stacker; Super Bikes; Wizard Of Oz.
findings.note: South Foreshore / South Shields Oasis. Broad non-rhythm catalog; no music games.

findings.name: Ocean Bay Amusements
findings.evidence_quote: Pier Gardens, Gorleston-on-Sea - ZIv hours only; no games listed.
findings.note: Gorleston pier gardens arcade. No rhythm evidence found.

findings.name: Ocean Beach Amusements
findings.evidence_quote: Cabs: Balloon Buster; Bubble Bobble; Gold Fishin'; Jurassic Park Arcade; Lane Master; Let's Bounce; Luigi's Mansion Arcade; Mario Kart Arcade GP 2; Milk Jug Toss; Pearl Fishery; Stacker; HOTD Scarlet Dawn.
findings.note: South Foreshore Ocean Beach (near Oasis). Listed family/redemption/video set without rhythm titles.

findings.name: Ocean Exmouth
findings.evidence_quote: Mainly Sega Arcade Games here (hence it's managed by the company itself), but only a few redemption games. Games: Daytona Championship USA; H2Overdrive; Sega Rally 3; Let's Go Jungle; Luigi's Mansion; Target Bravo; Transformers: Shadows Rising; Plants Vs Zombies; Sonic sports hockey/basketball.
findings.note: Sega-managed Exmouth seafront arcade. Full non-rhythm video list; no music games.

findings.name: Odeon Dudley
findings.evidence_quote: DSEM2 is no longer here, but guitar hero arcade still is. (Updated 2023-11-28). Games table empty of formal entries.
findings.note: Merry Hill Odeon foyer arcade. Dance Stage Euromix 2 removed. Guitar Hero Arcade still reported 2023 (maps as other; not a named bemani slug). Unverified whether GH remains in 2026.

findings.name: Odeon Luxe Birmingham
findings.evidence_quote: Current games: OutRun 2; Super Bikes. Pictures titled 'AMC Cinema (Birmingham) - SuperNOVA' / SuperNOVA Title (historical DDR SuperNOVA). Updated 2019-10-04.
findings.note: Broadway Plaza Odeon. Historical SuperNOVA photos; current ZIv list is racing only and stale 2019. Cannot confirm presence or absence of ddr in 2026.
